connections.title: Connected tools
connections.hero: Connect the tools you already use so your specialists can work inside them.

common.view_only: View only. Ask an admin to make changes.

providers.generic: Lets your specialists work inside this tool, with your approval.

providers.notion: Lets Sino read your notes and pages, so answers use what you already wrote.

providers.midtrans: Lets Sino read your payments and balance. It can never move money.

consent.title: Connect {app} to {workspace}
consent.scope_personal_fixed: This is your own connection. Only you can see it.
consent.allow_changes: Also let specialists make changes (you approve each one)
consent.personal_note: Only you can see and use this connection.
consent.none_use_it: No specialist uses this tool yet. You choose who gets access after connecting.

consent.error_rate_limited: Too many tries. Wait a moment and try again.

handoff.body: Sign in there and choose Allow. You will come back here afterwards.

form.intro: Paste your key here. Sineva tests it first, stores it encrypted and never shows it again. If the test fails, nothing is saved.

form.reminder: We will remind you in {days} days to replace this key.
form.read_only_note: Sineva only reads payments. It cannot move money, even if this key could.
form.error_rejected: {app} did not accept this key. Check that you copied all of it.
form.error_unreachable: We could not reach {app}. Your key was not saved. Try again.
form.error_duplicate: This account is already connected. Replace its key instead.
form.error_rate_limited: Too many tries. Wait a moment and try again.
form.error_generic: We could not save this. Nothing was changed. Try again.
form.discard_body: Your key has not been saved.

detail.revoked: Disconnected on {date}. Sineva no longer has access.
